preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n for n, a in [(int(input().split()[0]), list(map(int, input().split()))) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the visiting order list a is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(a[0] == 1 for _, a in [(int(input().split()[0]), list(map(int, input().split()))) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first element of the visiting order list a is 1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(a)) == n for _, a in [(int(input().split()[0]), list(map(int, input().split()))) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all elements in the visiting order list a are unique.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) for n, a in [(int(input().split()[0]), list(map(int, input().split()))) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all elements in the visiting order list a are between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(h, int) and h >= 0 for h in return_value)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output height h is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(h == max(len(path) - 1 for path in all_paths if path[0] == 1) for h, (n, a) in zip(return_value, [(int(input().split()[0]), list(map(int, input().split()))) for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output height h is the maximum depth of any path in the tree starting from the root vertex 1.
